FOREVE_EVENT_OGIER_KNIGHTS_TRIAL.title: Knight's Trial
FOREVE_EVENT_OGIER_KNIGHTS_TRIAL.pages.I: An ancient knight's spirit stands in the center of the trial grounds, studying you with a piercing gaze.
Take 7 damage. Obtain the Spear of Seven Arts.
Remove a random Skill from your deck. Obtain Honesty.
FOREVE_EVENT_OGIER_KNIGHTS_TRIAL.pages.T: You grasp the spear and feel ancient mastery flow into you. Obtained the Spear of Seven Arts.
FOREVE_EVENT_OGIER_KNIGHTS_TRIAL.pages.R: You recite the knight's tenets and your heart grows clear. Obtained Honesty.
FOREVE_EVENT_OGIER_KNIGHTS_TRIAL.pages.L: You turn and leave with steady steps, your wounds slightly better.
FOREVE_EVENT_OGIER_PRINCESS_GIFT.title: Princess's Gift
FOREVE_EVENT_OGIER_PRINCESS_GIFT.pages.I: A princess waits in the garden, cradling a glowing medal in her hands.
Take 15 damage. Obtain the Virtue of Seven Arts.
FOREVE_EVENT_OGIER_PRINCESS_GIFT.pages.T: You accept the medal solemnly, your heart of honor growing firmer.
FOREVE_EVENT_OGIER_PRINCESS_GIFT.pages.R: You politely decline, and a trace of approval flickers in her eyes.
FOREVE_EVENT_OGIER_PRINCESS_GIFT.pages.K: You kneel on one knee in fealty, and the princess bestows a lost martial art upon you.
